newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel says confident Germany to meet EMU targets.
newsitem.headline: Waigel says confident Germany to meet EMU targets.

text.p: Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Wednesday he is confident Germany will meet the fiscal criteria to qualify for Europe's planned single currency.

In the text of a speech prepared for delivery in Stuttgart, Waigel said Germany would limit its deficit to three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) this year as called for in the Maastricht treaty and urged strict observance of the treaty.
"Today we can confidently assume that we will meet the Maastricht criteria," Waigel said in the text of a speech to a banking association.
"Convergence determines the timetable for every country. For the German government a strict application of treaty when determining convergence is indispensible."
Waigel added Germany would achieve the three percent limit on public deficits, as called for in the treaty.
